end.parentNote: Kavya practised harvest festivals, regional celebrations, and how the same festival can be celebrated in different ways. They correctly connected Pongal with the new rice crop once and recognised that celebrations vary by region. The mix-up that festival dates are random was still present at the end of the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen: false). At home, ask Kavya to choose one festival and make a simple chart of its month, season, food, clothes, decorations, and connection to farming.
